summary: Uxin Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, disclosing that Chairman and CEO Kun Dai intends to purchase up to US$5 million of the company's ADSs in the open market over a 12-month period starting June 25, 2026. The purchase reflects Dai's confidence in Uxin's value and long-term prospects amid headwinds in China's used car market. No specific price per share or premium was stated; the plan is voluntary and subject to insider trading policies. Uxin operates as a leading used car retailer in China. The buying plan signals insider alignment but does not alter corporate control. Watch for actual purchases and any subsequent ownership increases.
